in_marathi.name: Amartya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amartya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds the nectar of immortality. In Hindu mythology, Amrta is the divine elixir of immortality, and Amartya is are those who possess or symbolize it.

in_bengali.name: Amartya
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amartya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who holds the nectar of immortality. In Hindu mythology, Amrta is the divine elixir of immortality, and Amartya is are those who possess or symbolize it.
